I have denounced polygamy, which is a doctrine of Mormonism, and I have said I do not believe D&C 132 to be scripture on that point or teaching. All of this shows I have moved away from traditional thinking inside Mormonism and from uncritical acceptance of later Christian formulations. I have not made excuses. I have simply presented what I believe the text teaches, backed by scripture, without resorting to logical fallacies in response to your points.

Christ’s Atonement satisfies the demands of justice and offers us mercy so we may receive salvation through Jesus Christ. We are saved by grace, yes, and the Bible and Christ also teach that we are to keep God’s commandments and produce good fruit. I appreciate the prayers. They will be applied to my continued, prayerful search to draw near to the Father through Christ and to know the truth of all things by the power of the Holy Ghost. That is what the Bible asks both of us to do.

Thank you for the exchange. Good day, brother.

Winterlight

A Candlelight Dinner Series

Flickering candlelight, exceptional wine, and the quiet magic of the ranch in winter—Winterlight is back. Returning to Alisal Ranch for the 2026–2027 season, this beloved series features three intimate candlelight dinners set within the historic heart of the Santa Ynez Valley. Last year, every event sold out, so we encourage you to reserve your seat early.

Step into a room aglow with hundreds of candles and settle in for an evening that moves at its own unhurried pace. Each Winterlight dinner features a thoughtfully crafted multi-course menu by our Executive Chef, paired with exceptional wines from a featured Santa Ynez Valley winery.

The 2026–2027 Winterlight series takes place on three Sunday evenings, beginning at 6pm with dinner being served at 6:30pm.

December 13, 2026: Stolpman Vineyards
January 10, 2027: Flowers Vineyards & Winery
February 21, 2027: JONATA & The Hilt Estate

Winterlight is one of the only events of the year open to the public, making it a rare opportunity to experience the magic of Alisal Ranch firsthand. Whether you’re planning a memorable date night or an unforgettable evening with friends, this is the kind of dinner that stays with you long after the candles burn down.

Guests are invited to make a trip out of it – book an overnight stay at Alisal Ranch alongside your dinner tickets and receive a discounted nightly rate, the perfect excuse to wake up on the ranch and explore everything the Santa Ynez Valley has to offer.

Must be 21+ to attend. Tickets are $175 per person (before tax and service fee). Cancellations made within 48 hours of the event will incur a 50% charge. Tickets are available through Ranch Concierge. Event begins at 6pm and dinner will be served at 6:30pm.

27 The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the Lord is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

2 When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.

3 Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.

4 One thing have I desired of the Lord, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the Lord, and to enquire in his temple.

5 For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.

6 And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the Lord.

7 Hear, O Lord, when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.

8 When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, Lord, will I seek.

9 Hide not thy face far from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.

10 When my father and my mother forsake me, then the Lord will take me up.

11 Teach me thy way, O Lord, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.

12 Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.

13 I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.

14 Wait on the Lord: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the Lord.
